title: Drytis Integration Readiness & Production Contract

step1_integration_boundary.auth_model: requireIntegrationAuth (JWT HS256 + legacy API token fallback)

step2_integration_flow.flow: Drytis Build → POST /v1/missions → QASE creates mission+session → agent runs async → findings collected → quality scored → decision engine → knowledge written → mission finalizes → Drytis polls or receives webhook → GET /report

data_locations.report: session.report + computed on-demand from mission data

step2_integration_flow.correlation_gap: correlationId is header-derived (X-Correlation-Id), not body field. generationId from body enables idempotency. No externalId body field — Drytis should use generationId.

step3_contract_audit.duplicate_handling: Returns existing mission with idempotent:true, HTTP 200
step3_contract_audit.retry_behavior: Safe to retry — idempotent when workspaceId+generationId present
step3_contract_audit.timeout_behavior: Agent runs async, HTTP returns 202 immediately. No HTTP timeout on mission creation.
step3_contract_audit.worker_failure: Mission status → failed, 500 response on creation failure
step3_contract_audit.mission_failure: Mission status → failed/aborted, findings may be partial

mechanisms.polling: GET /api/v1/missions/:id — primary mechanism, syncs session state on each call
mechanisms.webhook: POST /api/v1/webhooks to register, HMAC-SHA256 signed delivery with 3 retries
mechanisms.sse: GET /api/sessions/:id/events — dashboard only, not v1 contract

tests.name: Idempotent creation (same workspace+generation+target)
tests.result: PASS — same mission ID returned, idempotent:true

tests.name: GET /v1/missions list endpoint
tests.result: PASS — returns paginated list with total/limit/offset

tests.name: List filter by status=completed
tests.result: PASS — all returned missions have status=completed

verified: requireIntegrationAuth on all v1 routes — 401 without valid token
authorizeWorkspace — JWT callers restricted to their workspaceId
authorizeProject — JWT callers restricted to their projectId
authorizeMissionAccess — mission ownership checked before access
SSRF protection on webhook URLs — blocks internal IPs
Test credentials in-memory only — never persisted to JSON
timingSafeEqual for token comparison — no timing attacks
step7_security_boundary.note: Legacy API token callers get admin access (no workspace isolation). JWT callers get full isolation. Production integration should use JWT.

step8_integration_simulation.finding_sample: Created contacts are lost on page reload - no data persistence (critical)
step8_integration_simulation.flow_completed: Create → Poll → Complete → Report → Evidence → Idempotent Retry

pre_existing_failures: RL-1: sessions.json bounded size (pre-existing from multi-phase testing)
RL-2: session count bounded (pre-existing from multi-phase testing)

added: GET /api/v1/missions — list endpoint with pagination and filtering (server/index.js)
Pipeline-status endpoint: stages:null for summary-only stubs (server/index.js)

verdict: PASS — QASE is integration-ready for Drytis
